_doc: Part tokens. M4: move = the part's battle move (null = passive part; its stats still count) with power/cost(stamina)/acc/tags/keywords per keywords.json. Every part = stat-free M0 stub (name, ability flavor) + a 'shapes' drawing spec interpreted by render/renderer.js. Shape types: path, ellipse, circle, rect, polygon, line. Color tokens @primary/@secondary/@accent resolve to the part's species palette; @outline/@white resolve globally. Filled shapes default to a thick @outline stroke unless stroke is set. Local space conventions live in frames.json _doc. Limb parts are drawn once per near/far socket by the engine. Wave 1: parts are generated by tools/gen-parts.js from the species roster and the archetype shape library (tools/shapes.js) — a dev tool, not a build step; the game loads this JSON as-is. classAffinity is the anatomy that votes for a chimera's elemental class (see data/classes.json).
